answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available, and it is clearly non-zero, which rules out base. Top-1 agreement is 0.865, sequence agreement 0.344, TV 0.134 and Token-DiFR gap 0.496. All of these sit in the system-prompted range (0.861-0.908, 0.31-0.48, 0.108-0.144, 0.28-0.52) and outside the quantized range and mostly outside the fine-tuned range (top-1 0.900-0.938, TV 0.076-0.099, DiFR 0.10-0.31). KL of 0.454 is above even the system-prompted range (0.197-0.339), but it is still closest to that category, and fine-tuned KL tops out at 0.205. Raw-score shift ÷ TV of 4.2 is slightly above the system-prompted range but within what fine-tuned allows, so it is not decisive. Fine-tuned is the main alternative, though the top-1, sequence agreement, TV and DiFR values all point away from it.
